title: Anthropic sets share price at $83 for stock market debut, above expected range
summary: Artificial intelligence firm positioned for one of the biggest IPOs in history, with trading slated to begin Thursday Anthropic set the share price for its debut on the US stock market at $83 on Wednesday, positioning the artificial intelligence company for one of the biggest initial public offerings in history. The firm is slated to begin trading on Thursday under the ticker symbol ANT, with CEO Dario Amodei and other co-founders ringing the bell to open the Nasdaq exchange. The San Francisco-based company, founded in 2021, set a preliminary share price of $70 to $78 last week. With all shares counted, those prices put Anthropic’s initial public offering (IPO) from $1.26tn to $1.41tn, which would rank it as the second-biggest market offering ever. Elon Musk’s SpaceX debuted on Wall Street in June with a $1.77tn valuation. Continue reading...
title_en: Anthropic Prices IPO at $83 per Share, Above Expected Range
title_zh: Anthropic以每股83美元定价IPO，高于预期区间
summary_en: Anthropic set its IPO price at $83 per share, above its $70–78 range, valuing the AI firm at roughly $1.3–1.4 trillion. Trading under ticker ANT begins Thursday on Nasdaq, making it one of the largest IPOs ever.
summary_zh: Anthropic将IPO发行价定为每股83美元，高于此前70至78美元的区间，估值约1.3至1.4万亿美元。股票将于周四在纳斯达克以代码ANT开始交易，成为史上最大IPO之一。
